title: ZipPrep India regional knowledge source registry

authorityOrder: Union/State government primary datasets and gazette notifications
Official district administrations and government portals
UNESCO/UN Ramsar and other treaty-body records
rules: Every factual record must carry sourceId and sourceUrl, or an explicitly documented source record at the dataset level.
Do not use third-party mirrors as verified exam facts until cross-checked against the original government publication.
Historical Census 2011 figures must be labelled as historical and must not be presented as current population estimates.
Separate notified protected-area status from international recognition and conservation-project status.
Use official current district lists and dated boundary data; never equate map polygon count with legal administrative district count.
Record changes through dated snapshots so users can understand when a figure was valid.

Use an explicit 'None listed' entry only when a complete, dated official register covers the category and the State/UT is absent or explicitly has zero; state the register's scope and reference date. Absence from an incomplete source must remain distinct from none.

sources.name: Indian Bureau of Mines — Indian Minerals Yearbook 2024, State Reviews
fields: Mineral-based industries and listed installed capacities
sources.referenceYear: 2023-24; resource reference dates vary by table
sources.cadence: Annual; preserve each table's reference date and provisional/final status
sources.note: First economy-data batch: West Bengal mineral occurrences/resources, coalfield resource summary, 2023-24 sulphur by-product production and selected mineral-based industries. All plant figures are installed capacities as printed in IMYB 2024, not live output or proof of current operating status. Third enrichment batch adds Chhattisgarh mineral occurrences from the 2024 State Review; occurrence records do not imply active mines. Fourth enrichment batch adds Jharkhand mineral occurrences, dated resource estimates, provisional 2023-24 production and listed mineral-based industry capacities; occurrences and capacity listings do not establish current operating status. Fifth enrichment batch adds Karnataka mineral occurrences/resources, provisional 2023-24 production and selected mineral-based industry capacities; listed capacities are not live output. Sixth enrichment batch adds Rajasthan mineral occurrences/resources (including 2020 resource and 2024 lignite reference dates), provisional 2023-24 production and principal mineral-based industry capacities. IBM notes that current status of each listed mineral-based industry is not readily available; capacity entries are therefore yearbook listings, not live operating-status claims. Seventh enrichment batch adds Madhya Pradesh mineral occurrences/resources, coalfield resources as at 1 April 2024, provisional 2023-24 production (including Panna diamond output), and listed mineral-based industry capacities. Current plant operating status is not inferred from capacity listings.

sources.issuingAuthority: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation

sources.name: WII / MoEFCC — Community Reserve information sheet
sources.cadence: Use latest WII/MoEFCC protected-area inventory; refresh when official data is updated.
sources.note: National total: 309 Community Reserves covering 8,464.13 km². State rows provide cumulative area; state counts are not inferred. Current ZipPrep import contains 84 named Meghalaya entries and 81 named Nagaland entries plus aggregate area summaries for nine states; this is a partial named-record import, not a complete national list.
